Tolik and I have accomplished multiple projects (mostly in payment area) both individually and "peer-programming"-ly. I was amazed by his high level of self-motivation, accountability and goal orientation. He was able to solve any problem properly and meet the deadlines. Tolik was a quick learner and was always open to enlarge his skills in programming. Also, he could adopt new development methodologies such as Agile and Extreme Programming easily and appropriately.
